title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Walpurgisnacht Rising Movie Unveils Main Trailer
content: The upcoming Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Walpurgisnacht Rising movie unveiled its main trailer featuring the theme song by FictionJunction on Monday. It is set to premiere in Japan on August 28 . Studio Shaft will animate the movie.
